items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: But I spent half a night with him that night. And he encouraged me a whole lot, you know. I told him I liked to play a trumpet, I was trying, and he gave me some encouragement.

ctx.x: No. Did you meet him later again?

Oh, I saw him a few times after that, you know. But I spent half a night with him that night. And he encouraged me a whole lot, you know. I told him I liked to play a trumpet, I was trying, and he gave me some encouragement. That's wonderful. Yeah.
